mentions.name: Budget Unity Body/Facial Mocap Solution
mentions.description: A budget body and facial motion capture solution for Unity that bundles together free, cheap, and open source components. For facial capture it includes a custom converter from Deadface (Mediapipe-based) output with ARKit blendshapes and eye movement. For body capture it uses a custom hook to SlimeVR that enables mocap with cheap IMU-based DIY trackers. It also incorporates a custom (open source, paid) physics rig solution providing accurate rigid body real-time collision that saves on cleanup work. It is planned for release as a plugin for an in-development sandbox game.
mentions.problem: Motion capture is hard, and existing solutions are locked behind subscriptions or are very expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working for some time on a budget body/facial mocap solution with Unity. Mocap is hard, and what exists is locked behind subscriptions or is just very expensive.
